002-2. QINGZI IS ALWAYS LIKE THIS, WHEN HE HAS TO TALK ABOUT SOMETHING HE DOESN'T WANT TO TALK ABOUT,HELL JUST SAY A BUNCH OF NOTHING IN THE END.
002-3. ONLY A FOOL WOULD REVEAL HIS PLAN TO THE POLICE.
002-4. THE OLD MAN HAS ALREADYCONTACTED SOME PEOPLE A FEW DAYS AGO AND ASKED ME TO FIND SOME TIME TO VISIT THEM IN ORDER TO FIGURE OUT A SOLUTION.
002-5. I CAN'T GO EMPTY-HANDED, BUTIT DOESN'TMAKE SENSE TO BRINGCIGARETTESANDALCOHOL. I DON'T KNOW IF THEY'LL ACCEPT TEA LEAVES THAT IS WORTH SEVERAL THOUSANDYUAN.

002-11. -- QINGZI!

Page 003
003-1. WHAT!
003-2. TURNAROUND FOR A MOMENT!
003-3. AHEM!
003-4. LET'S SAY IF.. I MEANIF.I WANT TO PURSUE A GIRL, WHAT SHOULDIGIVE HER DURING THE MID-ALTUMN FESTIVAL?
003-5. THE MID-AUTUMN FESTIVAL IS A DAY FOR FAMILY RELNIONS. IFYOU WANT TO PURSUE SOMEONE, 'YOU HAVE TO CHOOSE A WESTERN HOLIDAY.WESTERN HOLIDAYS ARE THE DAYS FOR DATES AND GETTING A HOTEL ROOM.
003-6. DID I FUCKING SAY I WANT TO GET A HOTEL ROOM?
003-7. WAIT! THAT MAKES SENSE!
003-8. EVEN IF I DON'T GET A HOTEL ROOM, HANGING OUT ON A WESTERN HOLIDAY IS BETTER THAN DISRUPTING A FAMILYREUNIONDURING THE MID-AUTUMN FESTIVAL.
003-9. IT SEEMS LIKE HER FAMILY ISN'T AROUND...
003-10. I'LL ASK HER OUT FOR A WALK WITH THE EXCLSE THAT THE MOON- LIGHT IS BEAUTIFUL TONIGHT...
003-11. WHERE ARE YOU PLANNING TO GO? I'LL LIGHT SOME FIREWORKS FORYOU. THAT'S IT!

Page 004
004-1. THERE'S NO NEED FOR THAT, I WAS JUST CASUALLY ASKING.
004-2. LIGHTING FIREWORKS?! I'LL ARREST YOU IF YOU'RE NOT CAREFUL!
004-3. DON'TEVEN THINK ABOUT IT
004-4. HE WANTS TO PURSUE A GIRL YET HE IS ACTING LIKE THAT. WHEN LITTLE JIANG HE SAW HIM AND THAT GIRL GOING TO THE MOVIES, IT'S PROBABLY THE GIRL WHO SUG- GESTED GOING.
004-5. HEH一
004-6. ACTUALLY, THAT GUY, WANG ZIJUN, HAS A KILLER MOVE.
004-7. WHAT IS IT?
004-8. JUST SAY WHAT- EVER THE GIRL WANTS TO HEAR,AND THEN YOU CAN'DO WHAT- EVER YOU WANT.

Page 005
005-1. LREALLY.WANT TO BEAT HIM TO DEATH!!
005-2. WHEN WANG ZIJUN SAYS HELL BUY A BAG, HE'LL REALLY DO IT, BUT CAN I?!
005-3. PEOPLE ARE DIFFERENT, ANDIDON'THAVEWANG ZIJUN'S KIND OF TALKATIVE- NESS THATCAN COAX SO MANY PEOPLE AT THE SAME TIME..
005-4. NOW THAT HE IS MARRIED, THOSE THINGS SEEM TO BE BEHIND HIM.
005-5. I THINK WE ONCE SAID THAT WHEN WE GET MARRIED, WE WON'T GO HOMEUNTIL WE'RE DRUNK..
005-6. ONCE WE'RE REALLY AT THIS POINT, I SUDDENLY CAN NO LONGERGO BACK TO MY YOUTH.

Page 006
006-1. AFTER I GET MARRIED, IF I ENCOUNTER A KNIFE SITUATION ON THE STREET AGAIN, WILL I STILL BE ABLE TO RUSH FORWARD WITH- OUT HESITATION?
006-2. OR WILL I QUIETLY CALL FOR HELP AND NOT KNOW HOW LONG IT'LL TAKE TO ARRIVE AS I WATCH FROM A DISTANCE?
006-3. I WONDER WHAT SHE'S CURRENTLY DOING...
006-4. HAPPY WEDDING!!
006-5. THANK YOU EVERYONE!
006-6. YOU'RE ONE LUCKY GUY! YOU HAVE SUCH A BE- AUTIFUL WIFE!
006-7. OF COURSE! DON'T BE SHY EVERYONE, FEEL FREE TO'EAT AND DRINK TO YOUR HEART'S CONTENT!

Page 007
007-1. YOU REALLY DIDN'T DRINKA SIP OF ALCOHOL AND ONLY DRANK JUICE.
007-2. YEAH, THAT'S THE NATURE OF THE JOB AFTER ALL.I HAVE TO GET UP EARLY TOMO- RROW, SO I NEED GO HOME AND SLEEP SOON.
007-3. PEOPLE HAVE LEFT, LET'S LEAVE ALSO.
007-4. 小鱼儿锅#

Page 008
008-1. SHALL WEWALK AROUNDOR GO HOME?
008-2. LET'S WALK AROUND.
008-3. IT'S AUTUMN AGAIN,
008-4. THIS IS MY SECOND AUTUMN HERE.
008-5. AMANL AcloudMergacom

009-2. EIM

009-6. YOU'RE BETTING ON LUCK

009-8. LET'SGO THEN...

Page 010

010-8. IGOT ONE!

010-11. RISE IN FAMILY STATUS (PREPARATION)

Page 011
011-1. IT'S THE LAST TICKET...
011-2. THERE AREN'T MORE ZEROES AT THE END, RIGHT?!
011-3. I GOT ONE TOO, 5 YUAN! WE HAVE THE SAME LUCK!
